accept: degenerative mitral regurgitation with left heart dilatation

findings: Left atrial enlargement with broad P waves in lead two
Left ventricular hypertrophy with volume pattern

echoTasks.find: Prolapsing anterior leaflet with a posteriorly directed jet on colour Doppler
Dense triangular jet with systolic flow reversal in the pulmonary vein
Dilated left atrium and left ventricle with a flail segment in the long axis

auscultation.added: Third sound when the ventricle is volume loaded
auscultation.murmur: Pansystolic murmur at the apex radiating to the axilla, grade 3 of 6

exam.general: Middle aged man, comfortable at rest, mild exertional breathlessness, no cyanosis
exam.other: Apex displaced laterally, lungs clear, no oedema
exam.precordium: Displaced hyperdynamic apex beat with a systolic thrill

history.a: Breathless on climbing two floors for a year, recent drop in exercise tolerance
history.q: Exercise capacity over the last year

history.a: No chest pain, no syncope, occasional palpitation
No rheumatic history, no hypertension, no diabetes
history.q: Past heart history and risk factors

history.a: No regular drugs, takes no supplements
Bank clerk, sedentary, anxious about surgery leave
Father had a murmur but never sought care

keyPoints: Refer to the heart team for mitral repair assessment, as repair beats replacement for degenerative disease
Start afterload optimisation with vasodilator therapy where blood pressure allows, per the ESC valvular guideline
Treat atrial arrhythmia and anticoagulate where indicated, with rate control first
Counsel on endocarditis precautions and serial echo until surgery
Plan work leave and rehabilitation around the operative date with the family
management.model: Heart team referral for mitral repair with medical optimisation and serial imaging until surgery

sources: ESC guideline on valvular heart disease, in own words
ASE guideline on valvular regurgitation, in own words
stem: A 52 year old bank clerk from Bengaluru reports a year of declining exercise tolerance. A pansystolic murmur radiates to the axilla with a soft first sound and a third sound.
teaching: An axillary radiation marks the mitral jet, and a soft first sound marks poor leaflet coaptation
Effective orifice 0.40 sq cm or more with volume 60 ml or more is severe by either number
Pulmonary vein systolic reversal is the specific marker of severe disease
Degenerative severe disease goes to the heart team for repair, not to watchful waiting
title: Severe degenerative mitral regurgitation
